annotations.title: GEO check of a page for AI assistants

description: Runs the GEO SEO Records engine on a public page and returns the gaps, weighted blocking / important / to decide, across six parts: the door (robots.txt rules for the robots that read for a person), the map (llms.txt present and verifiable), the answer (does the page answer under its title, declared questions), the citable (figures with a source or a date), the publisher identity, and the structure (blocks that stay true when quoted alone). Free. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

url.description: The page address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page
